now.title: WandaVision
now.text: Monica Rambeau exposes Hayward, and he is arrested.

proposed.text: Hayward shoots at Wanda's sons in Westview, but Monica shields them and Darcy rams him with a food truck. He is then arrested.

changes.evidence: In WandaVision episode 9, Monica steps in front of Billy and Tommy to stop Hayward's bullets, Darcy rams his Humvee with a food truck, and the FBI arrests him. Monica does not expose him; the wiki credits Jimmy Woo and Darcy with foiling his plan.

now.title: Blade II
now.text: Reapers and sunlight kill the squad one by one, and Nyssa, the last, dies in the sunrise.

proposed.text: Reapers and sunlight kill the squad one by one, Blade cuts Reinhardt down, and Nyssa, the last, dies in the sunrise.

changes.evidence: In Blade II, Reinhardt is not killed by Reapers or sunlight: Blade kills him in Damaskinos's stronghold. Chupa, Asad and Snowman fall to Reapers, Priest, Verlaine and Lighthammer to sunlight, and Nyssa dies last in the sunrise.
